confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate with no live price checks. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals, cocktail, wine) are moderately certain for a Czech tourist town. Accommodation anchors are least certain because July is peak season in Cesky Krumlov and rates vary widely by location, season and booking lead time. The hostel and hotel values are bounded estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of mid-sized Czech heritage and tourist towns (for example Telc and Kutna Hora), with a tourism premium for Cesky Krumlov's UNESCO-listed old town and summer demand. Prague was not used as a comparable because its prices run substantially higher.
